name: Love As Old As Time
source:
Follow Rosette, the new Royal Gardener, as she wonders if she should confess her feelings to Vivienne, the Royal Librarian, before ten calamities inevitably befall their kingdom. But the legend of a hero chosen by fate -The Warrior Princes - and the embodiment of all evil -The Witch- might end up becoming too real for them sooner than they expected...

[Edited from [url=https://paletarosa.itch.io/love-as-old-as-time]itch.io[/url]]
